title: Reflow and read-aloud hosts through the CLI
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli passes; pdfxi reflow wraps real page text to a bounded width and pdfxi read-aloud emits a contiguous fixed-point utterance queue with page filter and seek on real fixtures; VIEW-013 moves to verified.
notes: Paragraph segmentation, greedy width-bounded wrapping, sentence chunking with slide-bullet boundaries, integer-millisecond cadence derived from --wpm, and seek rebasing. No audio device or speech engine is used.
